Package controller

Class AuthController

java.lang.Object
controller.AuthController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAccountManager
public class AuthController extends Object implements IAccountManager
Controller responsible for handling user authentication logic. This class implements the IAccountManager interface, providing services for login, logout, password changes, and retrieving information about the currently logged-in user.
Version:

  • Method Details

    • autheticate

      public boolean autheticate(int choice, String id, String password)
      Authenticates a user based on their chosen role, ID, and password. On success, the user is set in the Session. On failure, an appropriate error message is printed.
      Parameters:
      choice - The user's selected role (1=Student, 2=CompanyRep, 3=CareerStaff).
      id - The user's ID.
      password - The user's plaintext password.
      Returns:
      true if authentication is successful, false otherwise.
